content.rendered:
Ready for Kindergarten Play Days – Join us for one or both days to learn about school readiness, connect with other Kinder families and spend time with some of the amazing AG Kinder teaching team. This is open to all incoming Archer Glen kindergarten students and their families. 

Listo para Kinder dia de Juego – Acompanenos a nosotros uno o los dos dias para aprender sobre preparacion escolar, conectarse con otras familias de Kinder, y pasar tiempo con algunos de nuestro fabuloso equipo de ensenanza.  Abierto para todo estudiante entrante de kindergarten en Archer Glen y sus familias. 

At the Archer Glen Playground on July 12th and August 9th from 6;30 pm – 7:30 pm.

Patio de Archer Glen – 12 de Julio y 9 de Agosto, 6:30 a 7:30 pm

Kinder Ramp Up will be September 5th – September 7th.  One third of our new Kinder students will attend each day. Letters will be sent home in August with information on which students will attend each day. 
All Kinder students will attend on September 8th, September 11th and 12th. September 13th will be a No School day for Kinders as teachers will spend this day placing Kinders into one of the four Kinder classrooms. All Kinder students will start in their assigned classrooms on Thursday, September 14th.
